verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs fixed built-in automations: automatic PR reviews on push or on a `@foreloop retest` comment, an opt-in failure threshold, and feedback routing to a chosen project. None of the evidence documents a way for users to define their own event-to-action rules. Running the CLI from cron is a user-side workaround, so these are adjacent features rather than a user-configurable rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
